body:
I saved the bottle for you because it smelled like the trial orchard after spraying. I poured out the glasses before anyone drank, and the rinse water left a film on the sink.

The leaves on the pear tree outside the window had curled the same week. I could not mistake the empty place left for the person we had been waiting for.
title: Handwritten letter

body:
I put aside four glasses after the men came in. They said the others would be back for them and asked me to write the names on a napkin.

I watched them pour the drinks away when they thought I had gone. They kept the napkin, and one of them told me the names were not to be repeated to anyone, including the four.
title: Handwritten letter
